sentences.text: In compliance of the aforesaid order, the C.J.M., Pilibhit has submitted a report vide letter No. 101 dated 7.7.2017 and has informed the Court that both the parties have appeared before him and after proper identification, the compromise has been verified.
As the parties have settled the matter through compromise and the compromise has been duly verified, considering the nature of offence which is matrimonial, proceeding is liable to be terminated.
Accordingly, the criminal revision is allowed and the impugned summoning order dated 21.4.2006 is hereby set aside.
Learned Trial Court is directed to pass a fresh order taking into consideration that the parties have entered into compromise so the proceeding is liable to be dropped.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In compliance of the aforesaid order, the C.J.M., Pilibhit has submitted a report vide letter No. 101 dated 7.7.2017 and has informed the Court that both the parties have appeared before him and after proper identification, the compromise has been verified.
As the parties have settled the matter through compromise and the compromise has been duly verified, considering the nature of offence which is matrimonial, proceeding is liable to be terminated.
Accordingly, the criminal revision is allowed and the impugned summoning order dated 21.4.2006 is hereby set aside.
Learned Trial Court is directed to pass a fresh order taking into consideration that the parties have entered into compromise so the proceeding is liable to be dropped.
